items.q: How do credits work in Cosmo Translator?
items.a: Credits are consumed when you translate. Cosmo has three separate buckets: guest trial credits (free, one-time), subscription credits (refresh on renewal), and pack credits (one-time purchase). Subscription credits are used first, then pack credits.

items.q: What is the difference between Hands-Free and Press and Hold mode?
items.a: Hands-Free mode automatically detects when someone is speaking and translates without any button press, great for natural flowing conversations. Press and Hold requires holding a button to record, giving you precise control over when translation happens.

items.q: Can I use Cosmo Translator without creating an account?
items.a: Yes. You get 20 free guest credits when you first open the app, with no account and no credit card required. You will need a Cosmo account to purchase credit packs or start a subscription.

Subscription credits refresh when your plan renews and unused subscription credits do not carry over. Pack credits are yours until used and never expire. Guest trial credits are one-time only and cannot be replenished.

items.q: Which languages does Cosmo Translator support?
items.a: Cosmo supports 70+ languages including Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Arabic, Korean, Portuguese, Hindi, Italian, Dutch, Turkish, and many more.

items.q: Can I stack credit packs with a subscription?
items.a: Yes. Credit packs are completely separate from subscriptions and can be added to any plan. Subscription credits are consumed first; pack credits are your reserve.

items.q: Why do I need credits to translate?
items.a: Cosmo uses advanced AI models to deliver fast, accurate, and natural-sounding translations in real time. Unlike basic translation apps, every conversation is processed through these models which require computing power to run, and that has a cost. Credits are how we keep the service running while making sure you only pay for what you actually use. You can start for free with 20 guest credits, no account needed.
